toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Metabase is an open-source business intelligence tool that lets you ask questions about your data and visualize answers as charts, graphs, and dashboards.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=metabase. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="metabase") to create a connection BEFORE executing any metabase tools.

METABASE_METABASE_POST_API_EE_METABOT_TO.description: Tool to retrieve dashboard details for a Metabase metabot conversation. Use when you need to get information about a specific dashboard including its name, description, type, and verification status within a conversation context.

dashboard_id.description: The numeric identifier for the dashboard to retrieve details about

profile_id.description: Optional profile identifier. Can be null.

conversation_id.description: UUID for the conversation context. Required to retrieve dashboard details associated with a conversation.

METABASE_POST_API_EE_METABOT_TOOLS_SEARC.description: Tool to search Metabase items using the Metabot search v2 endpoint. Use when you need to find dashboards, questions, tables, models, metrics, or other Metabase entities using keyword or semantic search. Supports filtering by entity type, database, and dates.

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return. Defaults to 50 if not specified

weights.description: Optional weighting factors for different search criteria to customize result ranking

created_at.description: Filter results by creation date. Format depends on API requirements

database_id.description: Filter results to only include items from a specific database ID

entity_types.description: Filter results to only include specific entity types. If not provided, all types are searched

term_queries.description: Array of keyword search terms to find matching items by name or content. Use for traditional keyword-based search

last_edited_at.description: Filter results by last edit date. Format depends on API requirements

conversation_id.description: UUID string identifying the conversation context for the search. Used to maintain search context across multiple queries

semantic_queries.description: Array of semantic/natural language queries for AI-powered search. Use for more contextual searches

search_native_query.description: Whether to include native SQL queries in the search. Defaults to false

METABASE_GET_DASHBOARD_QUERY_METADATA.description: Tool to get all of the required query metadata for the cards on a dashboard. Use when you need to understand what databases, tables, fields, snippets, and cards are used by a specific dashboard.

dashboard_id.description: The ID of the dashboard to get query metadata for.
